title: Report: Windows 11 Telemetry Tracks Coding Agents and Developer Tools
summary: A post on xusheng.dev reports that Windows 11 is collecting telemetry on which coding agents and developer tools a user runs. The item is a single author&\#x27;s write-up rather than a Microsoft disclosure or an independent measurement, and the supplied material does not establish the scope of the collection, which specific tools are covered, whether opt-outs exist, or how the data is used. Treat the claim as an unverified report until Microsoft documentation or reproducible testing confirms the details.
